name: R043-superpower-speed-tie
why: Challenge 7, every Pokemon has IV 31. The opponent's Regirock (set 762, Superpower) has Speed 70; the player's Registeel (set 764, Steel, so Superpower is not resisted) also has Speed 70 and no Quick Claw. On turn 1 Regirock's Attack is not lowered, so AI_CV_Superpower reaches if_target_faster and draws the tie roll.
